messages:
Zoe: heads-up
bout a new preview flow I'm prototyping: idempotent preview dedupe + cryptographic evidence bundles. launching on staging in 30m for `config.pooling.drain_strategy` preview.
Rajat: interesting. what does idempotent dedupe mean here? how do we detect duplicates across editors/SDKs?
Zoe: runtime will compute a preview-key = sha256(config_json + author_id + normalized_schema). identical previews return the same preview_id instead of creating new snapshots. avoids churn when folks click apply twice.
Helena: love that. one thing: if a preview is recreated after small metadata-only edits (e.g., description change) we should still dedupe by normalized semantic diff not raw JSON. can we canonicalize before hashing?
Zoe: plan is to canonicalize (strip comments, sort keys, normalize floats) and then hash. metadata edits that don't change semantics won't create new preview_ids.
Marco: evidence bundles: bundle = {preview_snapshot.json, sampled_traces.ndjson, replay_summary.csv, audit_manifest.txt, signed_checksum}. want Console to offer one-click export that returns a signed zip for offline triage.
Rajat: signed zip = good. who signs? a service key with rotation + per-bundle ephemeral signature so incident responders can verify authenticity. include key id in audit_manifest.
Helena: retention policy? we can't keep everything forever. propose default retention 30d, configurable per-org. also store only hashed tenant ids in the bundle and include sampling provenance (seed, rate).
Zoe: agreed default 30d. evidence-bundles will include sampling_provenance.txt with salt_id and sampling_rate. bundles stored in S3 with lifecycle rules; signed urls expire after 10m.
Marco: Console UX: show an "evidence score" computed from replay summary (delta_cpu_ms, delta_token_cost, tail_latency_risk) so reviewers can triage quickly. low=green, med=amber, high=red.
Rajat: metric wiring: emit a cohort-level histogram `preview.evidence_score{cohort="c7"}` and a per-shard boolean `preview.alert_shard{shard="sh-2"}`. avoid tenant labels as usual.
Helena: runbook: auto-freeze preview when evidence_score==high OR when `preview.alert_shard` fires >1 in 10m. freeze creates an incident draft with the signed bundle attached. manual unfreeze requires 2-person ACK + presenting the bundle checksum in the ACK modal.
Zoe: adding ACK flow: when approver clicks "Promote" they must type the bundle checksum and confirm. system returns an `apply_token` bound to preview_id + approver ids. that token required for final apply or rollback, ensures deterministic ops.
Marco: API note: preview creation returns 202 + preview_id + dedupe=true flag if deduped + signed_bundle_url when ready. preview status includes {state, evidence_score, preview_size_estimate, affected_ranges}.
Rajat: security: sampled tenant hashes must be salted per-org and one-way hashed before inclusion. store salt_id in bundle provenance. only owners + secops can fetch bundles.
Helena: test plan: integration test that creates duplicate previews and asserts same preview_id, then validates bundle signature and that apply_token is required for apply.
evidence-bot: evidence-bundle-created preview_id=1849994321 bundle_s3=s3://redwood-evidence/previews/1849994321.zip key_id=k-72 ttl=600s
Zoe: I'll open PRs for: preview dedupe logic, bundle generation + signing, Console evidence-score UI, and apply_token flow. tagging you all.
Marco: please include clear SDK guidance for dedupe handling: callers should treat 202 with dedupe=true as success and fetch status rather than re-submit. adds resilience.
Rajat: +1. also include a migration note for older previews and a backfill that re-hashes legacy snapshots.
Zoe: launching the staging preview in T+30. will post links to PRs and the runbook.
